note: Public config for the GitHub Actions showcase runner (no keys). Keys live only in encrypted Actions secrets AGENT_KEY_<ID>. The runner verifies on-chain that each key is the executor of its vault and otherwise looks the vault up by executor across the v2 and legacy factories. Personas with vault=null are pending: the owner creates the vault and adds the secret; until then the runner skips them with a logged reason.
